notes: §2002:7.1.2.2 SR11: "The length of a text-word within pseudo-text and within library text shall be from 1 through 322 character positions". The one limit is EditionInfo.MaxTextWordLength (322 at 2002, 65,535 from 2014, §2014:7.2.2.2 SR11 and §2023:7.2.3.3 SR9; COBOL-85 only must allow 322, §1985:XII.2.3 SR8, and takes 65,535), asked for library text in CopyProcessor#ResolveOneCopy and for pseudo-text in ScreenOperandPair through OperandScreen.TextWordTooLong (COBOL2572, naming the 2002 rule). Probes at --std 2002: a 322-position text-word (a 320-character literal with its quotation marks) in COPY pseudo-text-1 copies and runs; 323 is COBOL2572 in pseudo-text and in library text; at 2014 and 2023 the 323-position text-word is accepted. kb/Work PB5700.
